# Animoro

> Animoro brings together anime news, reviews, rankings, watch guides, recommendations, seasonal coverage, an anime catalogue, upcoming anime information, and an airing schedule.

Animoro is a website for anime discovery and editorial coverage. Catalogue details, scores, and release information are shown when supplied by the relevant data source; they are not independently generated by Animoro.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://animoro.in/): Overview of Animoro and links to its main sections.
- [Anime List](https://animoro.in/anime-list): Search and filter anime by title, genre, format, and status.
- [Upcoming Anime](https://animoro.in/upcoming-anime): Browse available upcoming-anime listings and release information.
- [Anime Airing Today](https://animoro.in/anime-calendar.html): Anime release and airing schedule.
- [Anime News](https://animoro.in/category.html?category=Anime%20News): Anime news archive.
- [Anime Articles](https://animoro.in/blogs.html): Article archive with news, reviews, rankings, guides, recommendations, manga, and seasonal coverage.

## About Animoro

- [About](https://animoro.in/about.html): Information about Animoro and its coverage.
- [Contact](https://animoro.in/contact.html): Contact page for editorial tips, corrections, and inquiries.
